title: Item
paragraphs: “Buhii!”
The pig fiercely resisted, firing magic at us in defiance.
“Air Strike Shield! Air One-Way Shield!”
Father deflected it using his skills. Even as a counterattack, it was weak. Was it not meant for combat? As I was thinking that, a spell resembling something of Dryfa-class came flying toward us.
The knight looked shocked.
“Her Highness shouldn’t have been able to use such powerful magic…”
“If she challenged the Seven Star Weapon, she might be able to pull it out. Though by improper means.”
“Bububububuhi!!”
Now showing murderous intent, it charged straight at us. And it looked like it was trying to take the knight beside it as a hostage.
“What are you doing to the princess!?”
A knight with a strange look in his eyes appeared and tried to attack us. This feels just like the time with the ghost Crimson Swine.
“I’ll return those words right back at you! What do you think you’re doing to the heroes!?”
Rollick drew his sword and countered. As expected of a guard knight, he’s quite skilled.
“Bubububububu! Bubububu, bubububu!”
The pig was saying something to Rollick, as if interrogating him. Rollick snapped back at the words.
“The one I love is the princess, not the invader who has taken over her body! Get out now, evil spirit!”
As Rollick spat those words, the pig roared furiously in response.
“What is it saying?”
“It’s the same as always—‘The person I know wouldn’t say such things! I’ll definitely make things right! I’ll live my life the way I want!’—yeah, she’s making a fuss again.”
“For now—”
Ren and Itsuki quickly fired bullets into the foreheads of both the pig and the deranged knight who seemed ready to become its follower. A headshot!
“Well done!”
I gave a thumbs-up, but Itsuki looked at me with exasperation.
“No, we didn’t. It was a paralysis bullet…”
“Seriously, why is Motoyasu always like this…” Ren sighed in frustration.
I don’t know what he’s talking about. What’s the point of holding back here? The pig’s follower went down easily, but the pig itself stood firm, unfazed. It’s still full of energy.
“The disguise has completely fallen apart. This might be a way to distinguish those who are controlling a body.”
“First, I’d like you to help me with my experiment, okay?”
Come to think of it, what exactly does the doctor’s tool do? It looks like it can see souls.
“Bububububu!”
“Output boost.”

The doctor poured magic into the collar-like component of the Soul Vacuum. The suction power of the Soul Vacuum increased. Bit by bit, the target’s soul was being forced out of the body. At this stage, the soul seemed to be properly attached to the body.
“Bububububu!”
“Come on! Return that body to the princess! Even if the princess is no longer of this world, her body belongs to her!”
“Bububububububuhiiii!!”
Even though it was enraged by Rollick’s words, it couldn’t resist, and its soul was slowly being pulled out. However, this might still take time, and it felt like it might slip back in.
“Impossible? If it’s impossible, give up right away.”
It seemed like the Soul Vacuum was saying something to the doctor, Rival, and Assistant.
“I see… I can do it alone, but I might go too far…”
“That’s a difficult request.”
“It would’ve been nice if the heroes had Soul Vacuum-type weapons.”
“What’s wrong?” Father asked.
“Well, since we can see it through the lense, it’s okay to attack the exposed parts to weaken it. That’s what it said, but—”
“Understood!”
I stabbed the pig’s head with my Soul Eater Spear.
“Buhyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!”
The pig’s death cry was loud and chaotic. While I was at it, I yanked the soul right out. I dragged it out with a squelching sound.
“Whoa… It came out cleanly!?”
“Isn’t that bad? What about the original body’s owner!?”
“Exactly! Motoyasu, please return it quickly.”
“Whether it’s weakening it or returning it, this is such a hassle.”
“No, this is perfect. Just hold it down as it struggles and lift it toward the Soul Vacuum.”
Oh? Is this a stroke of luck?
“I was holding back because it’s hard to control the output, but if it’s this sturdy, I have no choice but to go all out.”
The doctor seemed to have raised the output of the equipment considerably. With a crackling sound, the suction power of the Soul Vacuum increased.
“Bububu… bububu… bubuu!”

Even after being pierced by me, the pig’s soul was being peeled away. On the other hand, the connection to the body was gradually being restored. Upon closer inspection, I could see that the coated part was peeling off. I see, this is where it was wrapped around. The Soul Vacuum moved in without hesitation and unwrapped the entanglement as it sucked it in. Eventually, the soul completely separated into two. One was a pig, the same size as the body. And the other… what is this? A hideous pig.
“A plump Japanese woman…?”
“Feels like an old lady.”
“Yeah, she doesn’t seem to have a very pleasant personality.”
Father and the others murmured.
“Bububu! Bubu!”
“Who are you going to sue!? We just exorcised an evil spirit that had possessed a girl…”
Another pointless argument?
“Well, it’s probably an envoy of the enemy, so it’s best to get rid of it.”
“Agreed. Soul Vacuum, do it.”

Following Itsuki’s command, the Soul Vacuum took a deep breath. The ghost pig fell from my spear and was sucked into the Soul Vacuum. It struggled hard, but in its soul form, it was powerless against the Soul Vacuum. It was devoured. With this, the enemy that possessed others and took over their bodies was defeated.
“My research has made significant progress.”
The doctor removed the equipment attached to the Soul Vacuum.
“B… bu…”
The pig weakly opened its eyes and spoke to Rollick.
“Bubu… bubububu…”
As it spoke, it placed its hoof on Rollick’s cheek.
“Bububububu, bubububuhi.”
“Y-Yes! I’m happy too! This time, let’s go for a nice walk together.”
Rollick and the pig seemed to be making a promise. Well, I have no objections to other people’s hobbies.
